title: Stargate within the mesa

tellings.quote: Hey, so imagine if there's a stargate within the mesa,

plain: There may be a stargate, a kind of doorway to somewhere else, inside the mesa at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings. The ranch's owner floats this himself on Michels's show, framing it as an idea to imagine rather than something he has seen, and it would explain why so much odd activity centres on that rock.
